description: Update policy (rationale: docs/updaters.md). Advisory fixes (Dependabot alerts plus OSV) for minor, patch, pin and digest updates automerge with no soak. Routine minor, patch, pin and digest updates automerge after a 7-day soak once CI is green. Major updates always wait for a human. Netcup-touching paths (scripts/**, .github/scripts/**, **/*.tf, **/.terraform.lock.hcl, examples/**) never automerge, security or not. Their routine updates group into one netcup-touching batch PR, except the Gatus and Caddy images in scripts/010-provision.sh, which sit outside the batch, follow the routine soak, and still never automerge when advisory. The OpenTofu pins (.opentofu-version and provision.yml tofu_version) move as one group. lockFileMaintenance is off; notifications use Renovate defaults.

customManagers.description: Gatus and Caddy docker images pinned in the provisioning script
OpenTofu CLI version pinned in provision.yml (setup-opentofu tofu_version input)

packageRules.description: R1 routine: minor, patch, pin and digest updates automerge after a 7-day soak (strict internalChecksFilter holds the PR until the age passes)
R2 majors (routine and advisory): human review, never automerged

R3 advisory fast lane: advisory minor, patch, pin and digest updates automerge with no soak. Soak removal comes from vulnerabilityAlerts (minimumReleaseAge null, force-applied). automerge cannot live in vulnerabilityAlerts because force keys win over every later rule, which would override the netcup deny rules (R4, R6)
R4 netcup-touching batch: routine and advisory bumps group into one PR with a label, never automerge. Gatus and Caddy are excluded here (R5)
R5 Gatus and Caddy images (scripts/010-provision.sh): outside the netcup batch; minor and patch automerge after the 7-day soak, majors human (R2)
R6 deny: advisory updates on netcup-touching paths never automerge, including Gatus and Caddy (placed after R3 and R5, so it wins)
R7 OpenTofu CLI pins (.opentofu-version and provision.yml tofu_version) move together
R8 pin GitHub Actions to commit digests (digest updates keep the # v1 comment pins current)
R9 OpenTofu setup-opentofu tofu_version input: a version string, never a digest (the github-actions manager reads it as a uses-with dep whose digest would not be a version)
